comment: The nethackrc sets name twice, and C reports the second as a compound option specified multiple times before the first key dismisses the error. The recorder (scripts/record-session.mjs recordSegment()) passes the first OPTIONS name: value as "-u Ottilie", and sys/unix/unixmain.c process_options() (385-396) copies it over the configured name after initoptions(), so the game greets Ottilie and ^X lists her (js/unixmain.js parseNethackrcName(), process_options()).
